top_signals.title: Philippines’ VP Duterte Posts Bail, Says She Fears for Her Life
top_signals.summary: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail for a criminal case accusing her of threatening to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. She said she fears for her own life.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
